news.headline: The Mayor of a City in Haiti Warned of a Massacre. No One Listened.
news.summary: The mayor of Kenscoff, a town near Haiti’s capital, wrote government officials hundreds of letters to warn of gang threats. Then dozens of people died, and he did, too.

news.headline: Katya Adler: France divided over who to blame for riots and what to learn from them
news.summary: In France and beyond there is widespread disagreement over what led to some of the worst unrest seen in French cities in modern history.
